summary.text: David J. Else, a farmer from Overton who has lived there his entire life, ran for the Legal Marijuana Now Party and lost the November 3, 2026 election for Nebraska's 3rd Congressional District to Adrian Smith.
He had run for the seat before, including as the Democratic nominee in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Else lives in Overton, Nebraska, according to the Nebraska Examiner, and Nebraska Public Media reports he has lived and farmed there his entire life.
The Nebraska Examiner's voter guide says he was a dairy farmer for 22 years and is a grain farmer and rancher with a cow/calf operation, and BallotReady lists his professional experience as farmer.
Else was the Democratic nominee for this seat in 2022, losing to Rep. Adrian Smith, who received 78.3% of the vote; Nebraska Public Media reports he also ran for the seat in 2024.
He won the Legal Marijuana NOW Party primary in May 2026.
He received 2.9% of the vote to Adrian Smith's 71%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
